memcpy: count 0 -> 0, bytes 0 -> 0, kinds none -> none
memcpy synchronous/pageable/legacy-stream: UNREAD (records carry copy kind and stream id only)
memset: count 0 -> 0

identity: Δwindow = ΣΔop + Δunmatched + Δmemcpy + Δmemset + Δidle + Δunresolved
          +0 = -72 +0 +0 +0 +72 +0 (exact)
coverage: (unmatched) is 0.0% of Σ|Δ| over the identity's terms

per op, ns. exclusive: each busy instant charged once (kernel > memcpy > memset, then earliest start); it sums to busy.
Δ split: Δ exclusive = count (launches gained or lost at the base's exclusive per launch) + per-launch (the rest).
mean, median: raw launch duration; summed: raw durations added up, so overlapping launches count more than once.
config: launch configuration (grid, block, dynamic shared memory) SAME, CHANGED, UNREAD (not recorded) or ONE_SIDED.
